name: Cuba
description: Cuba from the Taíno to Columbus, Spanish sugar and slavery, independence wars, the revolution, the missile crisis and today.

checkpoints.name: Taíno Cuba
checkpoints.note: The Taíno farmed and fished across the island.

checkpoints.name: Spanish Cuba
checkpoints.note: Columbus came in 1492. The Taíno died out, and enslaved Africans worked the sugar fields. Wars for independence began in 1868.

checkpoints.name: Republic
checkpoints.note: Spain was driven out in 1898, and Cuba lived in the shadow of the United States.

checkpoints.name: Revolution
checkpoints.note: Castro's revolution won in 1959. Cuba allied with the Soviet Union, faced the missile crisis, and struggled after 1991.
